name: Formal languages
description: Sets of finite words, and the grammars and operations used to describe and combine them.

name: Automata theory
description: Abstract machines that read words, and what they can and cannot recognise.

name: Regular languages
description: The languages recognised by finite automata, with their closure properties.

name: Finite automata
description: Machines with finitely many states, deterministic or not, and their variants.

name: Descriptional complexity
description: How large a description must be, for example the number of states of an automaton.
